imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The clothing-repair guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 412 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 28.22. The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs without reported errors or warnings; the few non-homepage queries in positions 4–20 each had only one to four impressions.
searchConsole.decision: No page is labeled Data-led because no query or page sample was repeatable enough. The discovery snapshot instead drove architecture: three unrelated evergreen gaps are exposed from the homepage, Library and three department hubs, reinforced by twelve reciprocal contextual links and the regenerated sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: One impression for ‘beard system’ at position 4, three combined impressions for two CDC jet-lag queries at positions 7–8, one public-Wi-Fi impression at position 19 and four capsule-wardrobe impressions at position 9 were deliberately ignored as too small or too unrelated to justify a query variation, exact-match title or rewrite.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the clothing-repair-kit guide. The shaving-irritation and dinner-party dietary handoff manuals remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready dinner-party dietary and allergen handoff asset that separates guest statements, ingredient evidence, cross-contact limits, kitchen ownership, service labels and emergency boundaries. It uses the FDA’s current nine-allergen framework and federal clean-separate-cook-chill guidance without promising an allergen-free meal.
authority.cluster: Shaving authority now connects beard systems, razor selection, facial cleansing and electric-shaver tradeoffs. Clothing care now connects label reading, hangers, steamers and alterations to a repair-first decision path. Hospitality now links menu timing, seating and service, cheese boards, food thermometers and recall response through one guest-safety handoff.
authority.opportunity: No outreach opportunity was logged: the highest-value action was the on-site reference asset, transparent sourcing and reciprocal topic-cluster reinforcement. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Grooming, Style and Life: how to reduce shaving irritation and razor bumps without self-diagnosis; which repair tools fit the actual garment and repair; and how to host around dietary needs and food allergies without making a promise the kitchen cannot keep. The repair-kit guide serves natural purchase intent, the shaving guide expands an established grooming cluster, and the guest handoff explores a practical hospitality risk. Analytics shaped crawl architecture rather than topics because its samples were too weak.
